summary: This note describes Jacoby Shaddix's role as host of the MTV show "Scarred" across its full run. He presented both seasons and all 20 episodes, which aired from April 10 to September 18, 2007. He later left the show because of touring commitments with Papa Roach, and the show's name came from the Papa Roach song "Scars".
one_line: Jacoby Shaddix hosted MTV's "Scarred" for both seasons and all 20 episodes in 2007 before leaving for Papa Roach tour commitments.
key_facts: Jacoby Shaddix served as the host of the MTV show "Scarred" for the entirety of the show's cycle.
